findings.passage: As the state representative for the Philadelphia neighborhoods of Germantown, Logan and West Oak Lane, I remain steadfast in my commitment to pushing for legislation that will help keep our community safe and free from gun violence.
findings.note: Statement in his office's release after a town hall on a shooting; no specific bill named.

findings.passage: “We’ve seen disproportionately too many folks who look like myself, and many folks in this community, be the recipient of harsh punishments,” said the 33-year-old Democratic candidate for state representative in Northwest Philadelphia’s 201st House District.
findings.note: Quoted by the Philadelphia Inquirer. The article says the quote concerns a 2021 House bill that would have set stricter sentences for crimes where guns were present, which he opposed.
subjects: longer sentences for crimes involving guns
